notes: The Pages/Design gallery stories render the public gallery export. Its theme control changes the whole gallery. The narrow story uses the phone viewport.
The story renders the public component with local fixture data. Global controls set the theme and viewport.

The real terminal uses an in-memory transport with local ANSI output and keyboard echo. Connecting, error, unavailable, buffer gap, stopped, and read-only states use no runtime service. Unmount disposes the terminal identity.

The real application wrapper uses a synthetic agent run. The shared network boundary blocks runtime socket calls in Disconnected. TerminalSurface covers an active local transcript. This checkout has no TerminalView export.
